integrations_researched.name: Canvas API

imports: No import needed - available via document.createElement('canvas') or HTML <canvas> element
api_patterns.initialization: const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas'); const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

gotchas: Canvas size limited to 4,096x4,096 pixels on iOS devices
Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth animations, not setInterval
Set canvas dimensions via attributes, not CSS, to avoid blurry rendering
Consider device pixel ratio for high-DPI displays
Batch rendering operations for performance with large datasets

integrations_researched.name: WebGL

imports: No import needed - available via canvas.getContext('webgl')

gotchas: GPU memory limitations vary by device

integrations_researched.name: Local Storage API

imports: No import needed - available via window.localStorage
api_patterns.verified_against: MDN Web Docs - Web Storage API

gotchas: Storage limit typically 5-10MB depending on browser
Data stored as strings only - use JSON.stringify/parse for objects
Not available in private/incognito mode in some browsers
Synchronous API - can block main thread with large data

integrations_researched.name: MATPOWER Data Format

verified_package.name: MATPOWER Case Format v2
verified_package.install_command: N/A - Data format specification, not a library

api_patterns.initialization: Data structure with baseMVA, bus, gen, branch, gencost fields

data_structure.baseMVA: Scalar - system MVA base for per-unit conversion
data_structure.bus: Matrix - bus data (id, type, Pd, Qd, Gs, Bs, area, Vm, Va, baseKV, zone, Vmax, Vmin)
data_structure.gen: Matrix - generator data (bus, Pg, Qg, Qmax, Qmin, Vg, mBase, status, Pmax, Pmin)
data_structure.branch: Matrix - branch data (fbus, tbus, r, x, b, rateA, rateB, rateC, ratio, angle, status)

gotchas: All values in per-unit system based on baseMVA
Angles typically in degrees for input, radians for computation
Version 2 format uses struct fields, Version 1 used separate variables

algorithms_implemented.note: These are implemented natively in JavaScript, not via external libraries

power_flow_methods.name: Fast Decoupled (FDLF)
power_flow_methods.use_case: Large systems with weak P-Q coupling

recommendations.recommendation: Since this project has no external dependencies, focus quality improvements on: consistent naming conventions, documentation, code structure, and algorithm implementation patterns
Consider ES6 module pattern for better code organization - the project uses vanilla JS which could benefit from clearer separation of concerns
For Canvas rendering, follow best practices: use requestAnimationFrame, batch draw calls, implement dirty region tracking for complex visualizations
Establish consistent patterns across 20+ algorithm implementations: uniform function signatures, error handling, convergence criteria, and result reporting
Implement unit tests for numerical algorithms using known IEEE test case results as validation benchmarks

key_findings.primary_focus: Algorithm consistency and code clarity improvement (not library integration)
